xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5334: Workflow redesign D1 follow-up: commits wrongly 'not pushed' in detached worktrees, branch reads HEAD, Copy session id never shows

plan.title: Workflow redesign D1 follow-up: commits wrongly 'not pushed' in detached worktrees, branch reads HEAD, Copy session id never shows
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Three defects in the PAN-5291 conversation header. (1) listLocalShas in src/lib/overdeck/conversation-change-commits.ts runs `git rev-list @{u}..HEAD`; a detached HEAD has no upstream, so every commit reports pushed:false and the status line says 'N commits not pushed' for commits already on origin (handoff worktrees are detached on purpose). (2) ConversationBranchMeta.tsx renders branch 'HEAD' literally for a detached checkout. (3) ConversationHeaderMenu.tsx derives the Copy session id value from conversation.sessionFile, which /api/conversations never sends, so the item never renders even though rows carry claudeSessionId.
narratives.Proposal: Follow the PRD .pan/drafts/pan-5334.md decisions D-1..D-3. In listLocalShas, when @{u} fails and `git remote` lists at least one remote, fall back to `git rev-list HEAD --not --remotes` and return hasUpstream:true; with no remote keep hasUpstream:false. In ConversationBranchMeta render 'detached' with title 'Detached HEAD · <cwd>' when branch === 'HEAD'. In ConversationHeaderMenu compute sessionId = claudeSessionId ?? sessionFile basename ?? null, keeping the show-only-when-differs-from-name rule. Update features/conversations.mdx, docs/DASHBOARD-ARCHITECTURE.md and add changelog.d/pan-5334.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Do not change listLocalShas behaviour when @{u} resolves; `git rev-list @{u}..HEAD` stays the first query.
- Do not rename the hasUpstream field or change the ChangeCommit contract.
- Do not show which remote branch holds a detached HEAD's commits.
- Do not change the ⋯ menu height or layout.
- Do not change COMMIT_RESULT_LINE to match git's `[detached HEAD <sha>]` line; tool-output detection of commits made while detached is a separate follow-up.
- Do not add sessionFile to /api/conversations rows; the fix reads claudeSessionId on the client.
- No execSync anywhere; async execFile only.
- Do not edit changelog.mdx directly.

items.title: listLocalShas falls back to --not --remotes when HEAD has no upstream

expected_outputs: conversation-change-commits.test.ts and conversation-changes.test.ts pass, including the new detached-HEAD case

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1. In src/lib/overdeck/conversation-change-commits.ts, function listLocalShas (grep `export async function listLocalShas`), keep the first try (`git rev-list @{u}..HEAD`, hasUpstream:true). Replace the catch body with a nested try: run `git(repoRoot, ['remote'])`, split on newlines and drop blank lines; if none, return { shas: new Set(), hasUpstream: false }; otherwise run `git(repoRoot, ['rev-list', 'HEAD', '--not', '--remotes'])` and return { shas: <trimmed non-empty lines>, hasUpstream: true }. If either fallback command throws, return { shas: new Set(), hasUpstream: false }. Use the existing async `git` helper only (no execSync). Update the JSDoc on listLocalShas and the module header line that reads `` `pushed` is "not in `git rev-list @{u}..HEAD`"; without an upstream every commit is local. `` to say: without an upstream, a commit counts as pushed when any remote-tracking ref contains it (`git rev-list HEAD --not --remotes`); with no remote every commit is local; hasUpstream means the shas set is meaningful. Do not change callers (conversation-change-commits.ts `pushed: local.hasUpstream && ...` and conversation-changes.ts line ~276). In tests/unit/lib/overdeck/conversation-change-commits.test.ts add `it('counts a commit on a remote-tracking ref as pushed when HEAD is detached', …)` inside describe('listConversationCommits'): commit `first` with trailer `Overdeck-Conversation: conv-detached`, init a bare origin under `root`, `git remote add origin`, `git push --quiet -u origin main`, commit `second` with the same trailer (not pushed), then `git checkout --quiet --detach` (temp test repo, the file already strips git-guard from PATH). Assert listLocalShas(repo) returns hasUpstream true and shas equal [second.sha], and listConversationCommits({ repoRoot: repo, sessionName: 'conv-detached', since: SINCE, parsed: null }).commits mapped to [sha, pushed] equals [[second.sha, false], [first.sha, true]]. The existing 'marks commits on the upstream pushed …; without an upstream every commit is local' test must pass unchanged (its no-upstream step has no remote). Check how the existing tests reset the repo between cases (beforeEach) and follow it.
